senses.gloss: chuṭṭa, adj. or subst. nt. (also chuṭī; cf. Skt. root chuṭ-; perh. read chuṭṭha ? cf. Ap. chuṭṭha, Jacobi, Bhav., Glossar, said to = kṣipta, to chuhai, which prob. = Skt. kṣubh-), seems to mean (what has been) injured: -stūpeṣu ca khaṇḍa-chuṭṭaṃ (Tib. ral ba daṅ ḥdrams pa, what is damaged and injured, cf. ḥgrams pa, to hurt, Jä.) pratisaṃskartavyam MSV 〔ii.143.12〕; khaṇḍa-chuṭyā pratisaṃskaraṇārtham MSV 〔iv.136.10〕. In parallels sphuṭa (q.v., 2); read so ?
